description: Which Mango Inventory help page answers a question? Works without an account. Pass the question in a few words, in your user's language or in English, and the language for the links. Returns up to five help pages with the section that matched. Open the page and answer from it; if none fits, pass the question on with tell_us.

language.description: Language of the help-page links: en (default), de, fr, it or es. Use your user's language.

question.description: The question in a few words, e.g. "vans with their equipment" or "safety inspections". Up to 300 characters.

name: find_docs

section.description: The heading on that page that matched

title: Find a help page
